content.text: Haha, Xiaomeng, look at this group photo! Do you remember the moment we raised our glasses to celebrate during our dinner last Saturday? It was from that 'thank-you banquet' we planned last time, in the private room of the Cantonese restaurant. I saved it on purpose—it feels especially meaningful.

Wow, this photo is really well taken! The green plants in the background and the scenery outside the window are both beautiful, and the atmosphere is so warm. Thank you for keeping it, it reminds me of how happy everyone was that day. It feels more heartfelt than the Chinese-style restaurant photos you shared before, especially since it was an event we planned ourselves.

Exactly! And look at this one—the 'battle results' after the group dinner. Check out our 'Clean Plate Campaign'—impressive, right? The Tom Yum soup was completely gone, and the dessert presentation was perfect for photos. It reminds me of the 'Most Adorable Contrast Award' you designed for our previous pet social event—both focused on interaction and experience. By the way, here’s an idea for a food exploration video: I’m thinking of filming 'How to Achieve the Clean Plate Campaign at a Trendy Restaurant,' combining it with my dramatic flair. What do you think?

Haha, it really is great! I also think our dinner gathering was quite successful. Everyone had a great time, just like when we planned the script-killing game for beginners—preparing in advance definitely makes a difference. I’ll definitely help promote the video you took! But weren’t you busy with game streaming and advertising planning before? What made you suddenly want to start filming shop exploration videos?

Well, this was inspired by our previous pet meetups and script murder events! From comforting you after losing streaks in games, to creating social media accounts for the 'boss,' and even planning offline activities, I've realized that life is full of interesting things everywhere, and I want to try more new content. Besides, you remember my core value of 'fun first,' right? Making these kinds of videos not only shares joy but also connects people—how great is that! Just like how I always try to entertain the audience during my live streams.

Well said! From losing streaks in games to pet communities, and then to beginner sessions of script murder, we've been growing together all along. Your idea is quite practical—it helps everyone avoid waste and increases interaction. Do you need my help with planning or contacting restaurants? Just like the division of labor in the previous pet event, I'll handle operations and details, while you take care of creativity and promotion.

Haha, you're always so thoughtful! But this time, I'll give it a try myself first and shoot some footage to see how it turns out. The gaming tips and skin collection experiences you shared earlier made me realize that content creation should be taken step by step, just like your progress from a losing streak to becoming a top mid-laner. By the way, how have you been doing at work lately? Still busy with user operations and blogger content?

Yeah, the company has a new project recently, so things have been pretty busy. But I'm still keeping up with updates on my lifestyle blog, sharing some practical tips. Just like we discussed during our gathering, harmonious relationships and emotional support are really important. How about you? Any progress with your game streaming and ad planning? The feedback from your fans on the achievements and skin effects you shared earlier must have been good, right?

The live streams are going okay, and my follower count is slowly growing. It might be related to the gameplay highlights I shared earlier and the sci-fi style skin for Lan. As for advertising planning, I recently took on a new client with quite challenging requirements, but I enjoy this feeling of living in the moment. You mentioned before that I have a strong sense of humor. For this video, I’m thinking of adding some dramatic flair, just like I do during my live streams. Do you think that would attract more viewers?

Of course you can! Your outgoing and lively personality is perfect for video content. However, remember to balance fun and practicality, just like we discussed in our pet community operations—content should be valuable. Would you like me to take a look at your script or offer suggestions? I’m quite observant and might be able to help, just like when I helped you choose the scripts for *The Whale Circus* and *Farewell Poem*.

That's great! You're truly my golden partner. From gaming to offline activities, and even content creation, you always give me support. Once I have a draft, I'll definitely send it to you for a look. By the way, have you tried any new games recently? Or are you still playing the one we teamed up on before?

I play occasionally, but I don't have much time to practice anymore. However, I still remember the techniques you taught me and the hero rankings you recommended, and I've improved a lot. I'm putting more energy into work and content creation as a blogger, exploring some commercialization models. Just like we discussed group buying for pet supplies, I want to provide practical value for the community.

Wow, you're becoming more and more business-savvy! Rejecting boredom and living in the moment—I think that's great. Once I finish filming my store exploration video, maybe we can collaborate on a joint promotion. Just like when we plan a scripted murder mystery game, we always manage to make things both fun and practical. From sharing game skins to creating pet IPs, our collaboration model is becoming more and more refined.

Haha, that's a great idea! From gaming partners to event planning collaborators, and now companions in entertainment exploration, our teamwork is becoming more and more seamless. Looking forward to your video, and remember to uphold the spirit of the "Clean Plate Campaign"—don’t waste food! Just like how we paid attention to details when planning events before.

Don't worry, I may be a bit of a drama queen, but I never waste anything! This gathering was a success, all thanks to your strong organizational skills and the way you took such good care of everyone—just like how you meticulously designed the pet event posters and schedules before. Next time there’s a themed gathering, let’s plan it together again, okay?

Of course! Harmonious relationships and mutual growth are my core values, and working with you is always a pleasure. Alright then, I’ll get back to work now. Looking forward to updates on the video, just like waiting for news about the script-killing team before.
Alright, talk later! Stay fun, avoid boredom, let's plan another game or activity next time! Just like we said when we first arranged a game, fun comes first!
